title: About Me
metaDescription:
Fourth Year Industrial Design student | Born and raised in Boston, Massachusetts 

From a young age, I’ve been drawn to what exists beyond the obvious, constantly exploring new ways to push creative boundaries. I believe that true understanding of the world, of both living and technological systems, and of one another must come before any meaningful creation. Guided by a deep appreciation for the natural world, I believe we must design with it, rather than for it, responding to its rhythms and needs with care, curiosity, and pure intention.
